choices.memoryHint: A rain collector appears beside an old planting bed.

chapters.title: The Courtyard's Warm Corner
chapters.intro: The photographs show a sheltered cupboard where clean cloth and wooden trays were kept. Salome points to it as the source of her own association. Bastien sees a way to make their disagreement part of the work without staging it as a contest. They can gather distinct descriptions from adult former staff or reconstruct the documented layout before adding more personal accounts.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to gather separate descriptions or reconstruct the documented layout.

choices.label: Gather separate descriptions
choices.outcome: Contributors describe the place without being shown Bastien's preferred vocabulary first. Several mention rain; others mention warmed wood, cooking or cleaning. The archive preserves the differences rather than combining them into a scent everyone is supposed to recognize.
choices.memoryHint: Contributors describe the place without being shown Bastien's preferred vocabulary first.

choices.label: Reconstruct the documented layout
choices.outcome: The layout connects the rain collector, planting bed and warm storage corner. Bastien can explain why different experiences might belong to the same place. The diagram gives their memories context without ranking either as a better instrument.
choices.memoryHint: The layout connects the rain collector, planting bed and warm storage corner.

echoes.bastien_c1_a: Earlier in your journey: The accession trail leads to a series of experimental compositions made for the hotel, not a bottle of its actual rain.
echoes.bastien_c1_b: Earlier in your journey: A rain collector appears beside an old planting bed.

chapters.title: A Formula With Two Hands
chapters.intro: A notebook contains several revisions in different handwritings. One page is marked not for demonstration. The collection agreement permits research but leaves public use of that page unresolved. Bastien can document the notebook without using the restricted material or ask the rights holders about a separately agreed demonstration. His wish for an evocative exhibition does not settle the question.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to document the permitted material only or seek permission for a bounded demonstration.

choices.label: Document the permitted material only
choices.outcome: Bastien describes the revision history and leaves the restricted page out of demonstrations and images. The account has a visible gap that he explains plainly. Salome finds it more convincing than a reconstruction whose permission no one can trace.
choices.memoryHint: Bastien describes the revision history and leaves the restricted page out of demonstrations and images.

choices.label: Seek permission for a bounded demonstration
choices.outcome: The rights holders agree to a limited demonstration of selected material and keep other details private. Bastien records the scope and the practical access conditions. A successful request does not become a license to disclose the entire notebook.
choices.memoryHint: The rights holders agree to a limited demonstration of selected material and keep other details private.

echoes.bastien_c2_a: Earlier in your journey: Contributors describe the place without being shown Bastien's preferred vocabulary first.
echoes.bastien_c2_b: Earlier in your journey: The layout connects the rain collector, planting bed and warm storage corner.

chapters.title: A Weather That Cannot Testify
chapters.intro: The bottle's history is clearer: it belongs to a maker's interpretation of a courtyard, revised over time. It cannot testify that every visitor experienced the same place. Bastien can present one documented composition with contrasting accounts or several contemporary responses labeled as new work. Either route gives up the attractive promise of recovering a vanished courtyard exactly.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to present the documented composition and contrasting accounts or commission clearly labeled new responses.

choices.label: Present the documented composition and contrasting accounts
choices.outcome: The presentation separates the object, its known history and people's descriptions. A scent-free route provides the same narrative through text and images. Bastien stops correcting a visitor who finds nothing rainy in the sample.
choices.memoryHint: The presentation separates the object, its known history and people's descriptions.

choices.label: Commission clearly labeled new responses
choices.outcome: Several adult makers create paid responses to the documented courtyard under agreed terms. Their works differ openly and include descriptive alternatives for visitors who do not sample scents. The old bottle becomes a starting point rather than a standard nobody can question.
choices.memoryHint: Several adult makers create paid responses to the documented courtyard under agreed terms.

echoes.bastien_c3_a: Earlier in your journey: Bastien describes the revision history and leaves the restricted page out of demonstrations and images.
echoes.bastien_c3_b: Earlier in your journey: The rights holders agree to a limited demonstration of selected material and keep other details private.

chapters.title: The Exact Memory Offer
chapters.intro: A client wants Bastien to recreate a departed adult relative's memories through scent. He can offer a composition based on the client's own approved descriptions or decline the premise and suggest a non-scent archive of the material they already have. He cannot recover another person's inner experience from a bottle. The difficult part is explaining that limit without dismissing the client's wish to remember.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to offer an interpretation with clear limits or decline the premise and help organize existing material.

choices.label: Offer an interpretation with clear limits
choices.outcome: Bastien proposes a new composition labeled as an interpretation of the client's descriptions, with no claim to recover the relative's experience. The client can accept, revise or decline it. The project begins only after that distinction is understood.
choices.memoryHint: Bastien proposes a new composition labeled as an interpretation of the client's descriptions, with no claim to recover the relative's experience.

choices.label: Decline the premise and help organize existing material
choices.outcome: Bastien declines the memory-recovery claim and offers a bounded session organizing the client's approved notes and photographs. No scent is required. The client leaves with less of a miracle and a clearer choice about what to do next.
choices.memoryHint: Bastien declines the memory-recovery claim and offers a bounded session organizing the client's approved notes and photographs.

echoes.bastien_c4_a: Earlier in your journey: The presentation separates the object, its known history and people's descriptions.
echoes.bastien_c4_b: Earlier in your journey: Several adult makers create paid responses to the documented courtyard under agreed terms.

chapters.title: The Sample Not Offered
chapters.intro: A visitor declines sampling and asks whether the written material tells the whole story. Bastien notices how often his demonstrations make refusal feel like missing the essential part. He can redesign the visit around equivalent descriptive material or offer separate optional sampling sessions alongside a complete scent-free presentation. Either approach requires changing more than the welcome sign.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to redesign the visit around equivalent descriptions or separate the sampling sessions.

choices.label: Redesign the visit around equivalent descriptions
choices.outcome: The studio supplies the narrative, object history and contributor accounts without requiring scent exposure. Optional samples remain clearly separate. Bastien tests the route with adults who choose not to sample and changes the parts they find confusing.
choices.memoryHint: The studio supplies the narrative, object history and contributor accounts without requiring scent exposure.

choices.label: Separate the sampling sessions
choices.outcome: The main presentation becomes scent-free, with distinct scheduled sampling sessions and clear information in advance. Bastien accepts a smaller sampling audience instead of making every visitor negotiate the same refusal at the door.
choices.memoryHint: The main presentation becomes scent-free, with distinct scheduled sampling sessions and clear information in advance.

echoes.bastien_c5_a: Earlier in your journey: Bastien proposes a new composition labeled as an interpretation of the client's descriptions, with no claim to recover the relative's experience.
echoes.bastien_c5_b: Earlier in your journey: Bastien declines the memory-recovery claim and offers a bounded session organizing the client's approved notes and photographs.

chapters.title: Salome's Correction
chapters.intro: Salome brings a copy of the advertisement promising the exact smell of the old hotel. Bastien's current presentation is more careful, but the claim still circulates online. He can publish a correction tied to that work or withdraw the promotional material he controls and replace it with a documented account. Neither makes Salome responsible for explaining why his language changed.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to publish a linked correction or replace the controlled promotional material.

choices.label: Publish a linked correction
choices.outcome: Bastien states that the work was an interpretation, not a verified recovery of a place's exact smell. He links the correction wherever he controls the original material. Salome approves only the use of her own contribution, not a story about how she saved him from certainty.
choices.memoryHint: Bastien states that the work was an interpretation, not a verified recovery of a place's exact smell.

choices.label: Replace the controlled promotional material
choices.outcome: Bastien withdraws the exaggerated copy he controls and publishes a factual account of the composition and its sources. He records what copies remain beyond his control. The repair is incomplete and no less necessary for being incomplete.
choices.memoryHint: Bastien withdraws the exaggerated copy he controls and publishes a factual account of the composition and its sources.

echoes.bastien_c6_a: Earlier in your journey: The studio supplies the narrative, object history and contributor accounts without requiring scent exposure.
echoes.bastien_c6_b: Earlier in your journey: The main presentation becomes scent-free, with distinct scheduled sampling sessions and clear information in advance.

chapters.title: A Bottle Left Unfinished
chapters.intro: The archive can conclude with a finite exhibition or maintain a small collection of future interpretations under agreed contributor terms. Bastien is drawn to the living collection, but knows how easily a promise to preserve can become an obligation nobody has funded. Salome watches rain collect in the ceramic bowl. For once he does not reach for a comparison before asking what future the work can support.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to keep a finite exhibition with a clear record or maintain a small weather library.

choices.label: Keep a finite exhibition with a clear record
choices.outcome: The exhibition closes on its agreed date, and permitted records remain available through the collection. Restricted formulations stay restricted. Bastien keeps an unfinished description card beside the bottle, accepting that a faithful account may include a stopping point.
choices.memoryHint: The exhibition closes on its agreed date, and permitted records remain available through the collection.

choices.label: Maintain a small weather library
choices.outcome: A funded, limited programme accepts new interpretations with clear permissions and scent-free access to their accounts. Bastien rejects the title exact memories for the catalogue. The library grows by differences people choose to share, not by claiming every rain belongs in his bottle.
choices.memoryHint: A funded, limited programme accepts new interpretations with clear permissions and scent-free access to their accounts.

echoes.bastien_c7_a: Earlier in your journey: Bastien states that the work was an interpretation, not a verified recovery of a place's exact smell.
echoes.bastien_c7_b: Earlier in your journey: Bastien withdraws the exaggerated copy he controls and publishes a factual account of the composition and its sources.

title: The Wind Map
tagline: A borrowed ribbon points toward a bridge made of cloud.
premise: My kite came back with someone else’s ribbon. It points toward a bridge I can only see when I stop trying to look straight at it.

chapters.title: The Borrowed Ribbon
chapters.intro: Anika's kite returns from an approved fictional observation flight with a strip of unfamiliar silk tied to its frame. The stitches form a pattern unlike Oren's workshop marks. From the window, its shadow seems to point toward a cloud bridge that vanishes when she looks directly at it. She can examine the stitching or compare the ribbon with stored wind maps before deciding what the sight means.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to study the stitched pattern or compare the stored maps.

choices.label: Study the stitched pattern
choices.outcome: Anika finds a sequence of corrections rather than a maker's signature. The ribbon describes changes in direction through repeated marks. She copies only the visible observations into her notebook, leaving room for an author she has not identified.
choices.memoryHint: Anika finds a sequence of corrections rather than a maker's signature.

choices.label: Compare the stored maps
choices.outcome: An old map includes a gap labeled as an unobserved interval, not a missing road. The ribbon's shadow moves across the same gap. Oren asks her to preserve the distinction when she describes what she has found.
choices.memoryHint: An old map includes a gap labeled as an unobserved interval, not a missing road.

chapters.title: A Bridge in the Corner of the Eye
chapters.intro: The cloud bridge appears most clearly in reflections on the window. In this fictional mountain world, certain silk patterns can hold a trace of a passing wind. That does not tell Anika who made the ribbon or whether any bridge can be crossed. She and Oren can compare reflected observations or inspect a stored demonstration kite whose pattern resembles the ribbon.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to compare the reflected observations or inspect the demonstration kite.

choices.label: Compare the reflected observations
choices.outcome: Several drawings record the bridge differently as the light changes. Anika keeps them all rather than selecting the most complete-looking span. The gap becomes a feature of the observation, not something she is entitled to invent.
choices.memoryHint: Several drawings record the bridge differently as the light changes.

choices.label: Inspect the demonstration kite
choices.outcome: The kite carries an older form of the correction stitch. Oren identifies the maker as an adult colleague whose patterns were never publicly catalogued. Anika asks what permission exists before treating the kite as a design she can reproduce.
choices.memoryHint: The kite carries an older form of the correction stitch.

echoes.anika_c1_a: Earlier in your journey: Anika finds a sequence of corrections rather than a maker's signature.
echoes.anika_c1_b: Earlier in your journey: An old map includes a gap labeled as an unobserved interval, not a missing road.

chapters.title: Oren's Folded Correction
chapters.setting: A pattern on the work table
chapters.intro: Oren shows Anika a seam she once simplified in a workshop demonstration. The fold held a note about uncertainty that her cleaner pattern removed. She can restore the annotation in her demonstration or create a separate revised pattern that explains exactly what it omits. The ribbon's maker may have been preserving a similar distinction. Oren asks her to compare the work rather than defend its appearance.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to restore the annotation in the demonstration or publish a clearly bounded revision.

choices.label: Restore the annotation in the demonstration
choices.outcome: Anika adds the fold's meaning to the teaching version and makes the uncertain interval explicit. The pattern takes longer to explain. A participant notices a detail she had missed while trying to make it look effortless.
choices.memoryHint: Anika adds the fold's meaning to the teaching version and makes the uncertain interval explicit.

choices.label: Publish a clearly bounded revision
choices.outcome: Anika labels her simplified pattern as a new teaching design with a narrower purpose and directs learners to the permitted original record. She stops presenting the missing annotation as an improvement everyone should welcome.
choices.memoryHint: Anika labels her simplified pattern as a new teaching design with a narrower purpose and directs learners to the permitted original record.

echoes.anika_c2_a: Earlier in your journey: Several drawings record the bridge differently as the light changes.
echoes.anika_c2_b: Earlier in your journey: The kite carries an older form of the correction stitch.

chapters.title: The Ribbon's Maker
chapters.setting: A reply carried to the workshop
chapters.intro: A neighboring workshop answers Anika's inquiry. Its maker Sela, aged 46, recognizes the ribbon and explains that it traces a fictional wind passage rather than a walking bridge. She agrees to share an account, not the whole pattern. Anika can build a joint observation display under those terms or keep a smaller account in her own workshop. Neither choice turns the passage into a real route for visitors.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to create a jointly agreed observation display or keep a smaller workshop account.

choices.label: Create a jointly agreed observation display
choices.outcome: The two workshops agree on what to show, how to name uncertainty and how work will be paid and credited. The display includes the vanishing span without promising that it can carry a person. Wonder survives a careful label.
choices.memoryHint: The two workshops agree on what to show, how to name uncertainty and how work will be paid and credited.

choices.label: Keep a smaller workshop account
choices.outcome: Anika documents the ribbon's permitted history and leaves its private pattern unshown. She tells visitors what she does not know. The workshop gains a story about another maker without quietly acquiring the maker's whole design.
choices.memoryHint: Anika documents the ribbon's permitted history and leaves its private pattern unshown.

echoes.anika_c3_a: Earlier in your journey: Anika adds the fold's meaning to the teaching version and makes the uncertain interval explicit.
echoes.anika_c3_b: Earlier in your journey: Anika labels her simplified pattern as a new teaching design with a narrower purpose and directs learners to the permitted original record.

chapters.title: The Map That Shifts
chapters.intro: The ribbon's trace changes with the season. Anika’s earlier drawing now shows a span that the current observations do not support. Anika can update the display with dated comparisons or replace the single map with a sequence that emphasizes change. Oren likes the old drawing too; that is not a reason to leave its claim untouched.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to add dated comparisons or replace the single map with a changing sequence.

choices.label: Add dated comparisons
choices.outcome: Anika keeps the earlier map as a dated observation and places the new trace beside it. Visitors can see that a beautiful line described one interval, not a permanent promise. Sela approves the use of the shared material in the comparison.
choices.memoryHint: Anika keeps the earlier map as a dated observation and places the new trace beside it.

choices.label: Replace the single map with a changing sequence
choices.outcome: The display becomes a sequence of permitted observations with explicit gaps. It is less immediate than one dramatic span. Anika accepts the slower reading rather than making the mountain hold still for her best image.
choices.memoryHint: The display becomes a sequence of permitted observations with explicit gaps.

echoes.anika_c4_a: Earlier in your journey: The two workshops agree on what to show, how to name uncertainty and how work will be paid and credited.
echoes.anika_c4_b: Earlier in your journey: Anika documents the ribbon's permitted history and leaves its private pattern unshown.

chapters.title: A Commission for Certainty
chapters.intro: A visitor centre wants a simplified wind map that could be advertised as a guaranteed path through the cloud bridge. Anika can offer an explicitly fictional interpretive artwork or decline the commission and keep the workshop display independent. She cannot turn the world's uncertain phenomenon into a guarantee, and will not allow the fantasy to function as real mountain-travel advice.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to offer an interpretive artwork with clear limits or decline the misleading commission.

choices.label: Offer an interpretive artwork with clear limits
choices.outcome: The centre agrees to a clearly framed artwork about changing observations, with no claim that the image is a traversable route. Anika checks the publicity as part of the agreement. A smaller promise leaves the imagined bridge intact.
choices.memoryHint: The centre agrees to a clearly framed artwork about changing observations, with no claim that the image is a traversable route.

choices.label: Decline the misleading commission
choices.outcome: Anika turns down the proposal and explains the distinction in a short public note without attacking the visitor centre's staff. The workshop loses income it had hoped for. She and Oren choose a smaller project they can describe honestly.
choices.memoryHint: Anika turns down the proposal and explains the distinction in a short public note without attacking the visitor centre's staff.

echoes.anika_c5_a: Earlier in your journey: Anika keeps the earlier map as a dated observation and places the new trace beside it.
echoes.anika_c5_b: Earlier in your journey: The display becomes a sequence of permitted observations with explicit gaps.

chapters.title: The Pattern She Cannot Improve Alone
chapters.intro: Sela proposes a revision Anika initially finds awkward: a deliberate break where the trace becomes unreliable. Anika's own version is smoother. They can test both as interpretive displays with adult visitors or keep distinct versions with clear authorship and purposes. The question is no longer who can draw the most convincing bridge. It is what each drawing makes a viewer believe.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to compare the two displays with visitors or keep distinct, clearly explained versions.

choices.label: Compare the two displays with visitors
choices.outcome: Paid sessions show that some viewers read Anika's smooth line as a promise. She adds a clear break and credits the collaboration. Sela changes another part after hearing a question Anika raises. The final pattern is not a disguised victory for either maker.
choices.memoryHint: Paid sessions show that some viewers read Anika's smooth line as a promise.

choices.label: Keep distinct, clearly explained versions
choices.outcome: The makers exhibit their versions together, stating their different purposes and limits. Anika stops describing hers as the improved pattern. Visitors can compare the consequences of a line without being forced to choose a winning author.
choices.memoryHint: The makers exhibit their versions together, stating their different purposes and limits.

echoes.anika_c6_a: Earlier in your journey: The centre agrees to a clearly framed artwork about changing observations, with no claim that the image is a traversable route.
echoes.anika_c6_b: Earlier in your journey: Anika turns down the proposal and explains the distinction in a short public note without attacking the visitor centre's staff.

chapters.title: The Sky Owes No Ending
chapters.setting: The workshop at the last light
chapters.intro: The wind passage is visible again, incomplete and extraordinary. The workshops can continue a funded shared observation series or finish this season with a carefully preserved account and no promise of another. Anika still wants one last unbroken drawing. Oren sets out a blank sheet beside the ribbon, not as a demand to finish it but as permission to leave room.
chapters.objective: Choose whether to continue a bounded observation partnership or close the season with an honest account.

choices.label: Continue a bounded observation partnership
choices.outcome: The workshops agree on a sustainable series with paid work, clear permissions and a record of failed observations as well as striking ones. Anika draws the new gap before the new span. The map becomes a practice of attention rather than a promise to complete the sky.
choices.memoryHint: The workshops agree on a sustainable series with paid work, clear permissions and a record of failed observations as well as striking ones.

choices.label: Close the season with an honest account
choices.outcome: The makers preserve the agreed records, return borrowed materials and mark what remains unknown. Anika leaves the last sheet partly blank. At dusk the ribbon lifts in a current nobody owns, and for once she lets the movement be enough.
choices.memoryHint: The makers preserve the agreed records, return borrowed materials and mark what remains unknown.

echoes.anika_c7_a: Earlier in your journey: Paid sessions show that some viewers read Anika's smooth line as a promise.
echoes.anika_c7_b: Earlier in your journey: The makers exhibit their versions together, stating their different purposes and limits.
